reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE (SIMPLIFICATION ARTIFACT): 66517915e09.c (Linux sound/AK4642). 'The value written to &codec_hw_write is never used' at line 24 ('int codec_hw_write = i2c_master_send; // ERROR'). 'codec_hw_write' is assigned but never used after the assignment — subsequent uses (write operations) were stripped by vbdb simplification. The real vbdb bug (// ERROR annotation) is that 'i2c_master_send' (declared only inside '#ifdef CONFIG_I2C') is used in 'ak4642_init()' without a '#ifdef CONFIG_I2C' guard — when CONFIG_I2C=false, 'i2c_master_send' is undeclared. The DEAD_STORE alarm fires when CONFIG_I2C=true (so 'i2c_master_send' IS declared), which is the opposite of the real bug's requirement. The presence condition CONFIG_I2C=true AND (CONFIG_SND_FSI_AK4642 OR CONFIG_SND_SOC_AK4642) describes a configuration where the dead store is visible, but the dead store itself is a simplification artifact unrelated to the real variability bug.
